name: Giannis Papadopoulos
bio:
Giannis's culinary journey began in his family's taverna in Thessaloniki, where he learned the importance of fresh, quality ingredients and efficient service. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, he saw an opportunity to combine his passion and skills by managing catering for racing teams. He started small, providing meals for local rallies before working his way up to international competitions.

At Peugeot TotalEnergies, Giannis prides himself on delivering nutritious and delicious meals that fuel the team's performance. He believes in a collaborative approach, working closely with nutritionists and chefs to create menus that cater to individual dietary needs and preferences. His attention to detail and creative flair ensure that every meal is not just sustenance, but a morale booster. He is known for his ability to adapt to the ever-changing demands of the racing schedule, always ensuring that the team is well-fed and ready to perform.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A stocky man with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small bottle of olive oil with him.
Has a specific playlist of traditional Greek music he listens to while prepping food.
Insists on using fresh herbs, even if it means foraging himself.
